draft.title: Support and sanction strategies
card: Managers can use support and sanction strategies to influence how staff behave and perform. One helps staff. The other uses the threat of a loss.
help given to staff to deal with a problem, so they can keep working well. Examples are counselling, flexible work hours and extra coaching.
a penalty, or the threat of one, if staff do not meet expected standards. Examples are a formal warning, a demotion or losing a bonus.
Support aims to remove what is holding a worker back. A sanction aims to stop unwanted behaviour by making staff worry about losing something they value.
draft.remember: Support helps staff past a problem. A sanction warns of a loss if standards are not met.

a.q: Which action is an example of a sanction strategy?
opts: A written warning that a worker may lose their job
Letting a worker start later while they care for a parent
Paying for a worker to see a counsellor
Offering a worker coaching to learn a new system
a.why: A written warning uses the threat of losing something, in this case the job, to push a worker to meet standards. The other three help the worker deal with a problem, so they are support strategies.
a.clue: Which one works by threatening a loss?

b.q: Priya manages a warehouse in Geelong. Tom is often late because his child's school starts after his shift does. Priya moves his start time by one hour. Which describes her action?
opts: A support strategy, as it removes the cause of his lateness
A sanction strategy, as it punishes him for being late
A sanction strategy, as it responds to his lateness
A support strategy, as it gives him a reward for being late
b.why: Moving Tom's hours helps him deal with the problem that causes the lateness, so it is a support strategy. It is not a sanction, because nothing is threatened or taken away. It is also not a reward for lateness, as it fixes the cause.
b.clue: Does Priya threaten a loss, or help with the problem?

a.best: A written warning that a worker may lose their job

b.best: A support strategy, as it removes the cause of his lateness
